scope: Independent review of the existing Editor720p close-view pair; not packaged acceptance, performance or a human playtest
acceptance: Accept the bounded authored-normal repair and shared-white-material finish for subsequent packaged verification, with the limitations below; not final photoreal quality
observations: The side view loses the strong dark vertical discontinuity across the central cabin panels; several large shading transitions are smoother.
The original low-poly outline, antennas, pad/ladder placement and terrain framing appear unchanged across these pairs.
The cloth treatment is subtle at720p and these views do not establish detailed fabric readability.
limitations: Large sun-facing cabin regions remain very bright and visually flat in both images. Literal channel clipping was not established: sampled central-white ROI [580,240,820,420] contains zero pixels with all channels>=254 in either image.
The hull silhouette remains visibly faceted; no geometric detail was added and this pass does not establish photoreal quality.
Large dark front/back panels are already present in the baseline; these images alone do not establish their source-material/lighting cause.
Only four explicitly listed existing images were visually inspected; no animation, FPS, human playtest or packaged build conclusion.

pixel_roi_check.scope: Small central white-cabin ROI only; not a full HDR exposure or material diagnosis
